audit_flags.label: Terra/Aqua annual detection ratio trend, daytime (pre-2012 stability)
audit_flags.threshold_rule: flagged if |Theil-Sen slope| > 2%/yr, or a single change-point with |delta| > log(1.15) and year-block permutation p < 0.05 (PREREG §7 C1)
audit_flags.note: CI is the Theil-Sen 95% slope interval converted to %/yr. Common-mode Terra+Aqua drift cannot be seen in their ratio. A flag does not change the record.

audit_flags.label: Aqua daytime detection floor: change in 5th-percentile FRP over 2003-2011
audit_flags.threshold_rule: flagged if |Theil-Sen trend x span / median| > 0.10 for FRP p5 or brightness p5
audit_flags.note: Brightness p5 relative change 0.0018. No CI computed.

audit_flags.label: Step in native Aqua/S-NPP ratio at the 2018-01 FIRMS version relabel (daytime)
audit_flags.threshold_rule: component flagged if |delta| > log(1.10) and exact permutation p < 0.05; 'notable' needs >= 2 core regions (Deviation D6)
audit_flags.note: Exact year-label permutation p = 0.486 over 35 splits (n = splits). Descriptive; cannot change the primary decision.

audit_flags.label: Change in native Aqua/NOAA-20 ratio, 2022 to 2023 (2023-01 relabel), daytime
audit_flags.threshold_rule: not evaluated: not separable from Aqua orbit drift
audit_flags.note: not separable from drift (Aqua orbit drift and Terra's 2022-10 orbit lowering coincide).

notes: sources[].archive is classified from is_nrt evidence (no FIRMS version label ending in 'NRT'; clip nrt_fraction 0), not from the version string. The MODIS labels 6.2, 6.03 and 61.03 are undocumented by FIRMS (docs/DATA-AUDIT.md).
Detections are satellite hotspot detections, not fires, burned area or emissions.
Modelled values are estimates of what Aqua MODIS would have recorded; status provisional unless validated.
Contract 1.4.0: the 5 M2 confirmation regions (tier m2_primary) carry value_kind on every value; m2_validation.json holds the M2 held-out evidence. M1 regions are unchanged.

m2_regions.name: Mainland SE Asia (N Thailand/Laos/Myanmar)
m2_regions.description: M2 confirmation region (agricultural); never used to build or tune the method

m2.design: leave-one-year-out over 2018-2021: each year was held out from the fit that predicted it and used to fit the other three; fit_years is that set, so there is no separate training year list. The 2022+ converted_unvalidated values use one fit on all four years.
